dossiers.catalyst_stack: On 2026-04-29 Alphabet beat Q1 revenue at $109.9B versus $107.2B and lifted 2026 capex to $180–$190B, then on 2026-07-22 printed Q2 revenue of $119.80B with Google Cloud up 82% YoY and raised capex again to $195–$205B. On 2026-09-02 a U.S. court rejected the DOJ’s bid to force an AdX sale, substituting behavioral remedies, with October follow-through transferring a Maps patent case and dismissing Chegg/Penske AI Overviews suits. Offsetting that, a 2026-06-01 equity raise of about $80B was upsized to roughly $84.75B, Waymo software recalls landed on 2026-05-06 and 2026-06-21, and 2026-07-16 reports that Gemini 3.5 Pro was months behind coincided with about a 4.4% share drop. Into mid-October, Constellation (3.59 GW) and AEP fuel-cell power deals plus Street PT hikes (JPMorgan to $425 on 2026-10-15) support the AI-build narrative, while Google is appealing EU demands to open Android AI features and share search data.
dossiers.key_assumption: The September AdX outcome stays behavioral rather than structural, EU AI/search-sharing appeals do not hit default Search distribution, and $195–205B of 2026 capex is absorbed by Cloud/AI demand instead of becoming an overbuild write-down.
